# `/suggested-entitlement-description-approvals` endpoints

Base URL: `https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com`

### POST /suggested-entitlement-description-approvals/v1

`submitSedApprovalV1` — Submit bulk approval request

Submit Bulk Approval Request for SED. Request body takes list of SED Ids. API responses with list of SED Approval Status

- Scopes: idn:sed:write
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, SOURCE_ADMIN
- Body (application/json-patch+json): array of sedapproval
- Returns 200: array of sedapprovalstatus
